definition: a small simple house in the countryside
description: Three homes shown in turn. An old man in a flat cap holds the plank door of a small single-story wooden cottage with a tin roof and a stove pipe, a tall sunflower beside it. Cut to a couple in matching tan jackets walking hand in hand up the path of a white weatherboard cottage with a red front door and clipped hedges, then a blonde woman presenting the same row of cottages with an open arm. Cut to a woman in a white suit standing in the doorway of a black glass mansion behind a still reflecting pool with palm trees.

to pose by a reflecting pool
